subject: Hosted API IO rates, model roster and committed tiers - Pathfinder Health
messages:
From: Elena B <elenab@pathfinderhealth.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-04-16T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quick ask — hosted API IO rates + model roster

Hi Laura,

We're kicking off procurement for a conversational assistant POC and evaluating hosted vendors. Can you send over Redwood's standard per-1M token rates (input / output split if you publish that) for the hosted API and a short list of supported models (latency tiers if available)?

A few specifics that would help procurement: 
- Baseline per-1M token price for standard models (e.g., base LLaMA-type families) and for high-capacity variants.
- Any published IO billing split (e.g., how input vs. output tokens are counted / priced).
- Do you publish discounted tiers for committed monthly volume? We're roughly estimating 5M tokens/month at POC, with a potential 12-month commitment if numbers look reasonable.
- Any sample SOW / pilot pricing or minimums for a 3-month pilot?

Attaching our short RFP for context.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick 20-min call if easier.

Best,
Elena B
Head of Product Operations
Pathfinder Health
[Attachment: Pathfinder_RFP_2028.pdf (PDF, 180KB)]

From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Elena B <elenab@pathfinderhealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-04-16T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask — hosted API IO rates + model roster

Hi Elena — thanks for the RFP and context. Short answer: yes, we publish IO rates and have committed-volume discounts. I'm attaching our standard ratecard and a one-pager model roster to get you started.

Quick notes while you review:
- IO pricing: we bill input and output tokens separately; the ratecard includes the per-1M input and per-1M output lines for each model tier.
- Discounting: for monthly commits >1M tokens we offer tiered discounts; for something like ~5M/mo we typically propose a mid-tier discount and a 12-month price lock (we can show a concrete quote once you confirm expected sustained volume and model mix).
- Pilot: we do 3-month pilots; pricing can be structured as a refundable credit toward a committed contract if you convert.

Could you confirm an estimate of: (a) expected monthly tokens (5M is fine if that's your current estimate), (b) the mix between embeddings, chat/generation, and high-throughput embedding-only workloads, and (c) any compliance/region constraints (do you need EU residency)?

I'll loop Aditya (sales lead) and Marissa (acct exec) on the next email for a tailored quote.

Cheers,
Laura Bennett
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_standard_ratecard_v2.pdf (PDF, 420KB)]

Answers: (a) For POC we expect ~5M tokens/month; (b) roughly 60% chat/generation, 30% embeddings for search/rerank, 10% structured prompts for data extraction; (c) US region only for now.

Procurement also asked for: a) a simple committed-price example for 5M/mo over 12 months (what effective discount do you offer vs list), and b) any minimum monthly spend or ramp clauses. If you can include an example line item (input/output per-1M price, discount %, total monthly expected spend) that would be perfect.

I've attached the RFP appendix with compliance notes — procurement will expect to see sample contract terms and a short SOW for a 3-month pilot.

Best,
Elena

Subject: Re: Hosted API IO rates + model roster — Pathfinder (pricing example)

Hi Elena / team — thanks for the details. Apologies for the slight delay — below is a concise committed-price example and recommended pilot language.

Pricing example (monthly, USD):
- Baseline list (per 1M tokens):
  • Standard models: input $7 / output $9 (list)
  • High-capacity models: input $22 / output $26 (list)
  • Embeddings-optimized: per-1M embeddings tokens $4 (single combined line)

- Committed 12-month 5M/mo scenarios (applies to tokens billed for hosted API only):
  • 10% commitment discount (applied to list): effective rates -> Standard input $6.30 / output $8.10; High-capacity input $19.80 / output $23.40; Embeddings $3.60 per 1M. Estimated monthly spend (60/30/10 split mapped to model tiers): ~$1,860/month.
  • 15% commitment discount (higher-volume incentive): effective rates -> Standard input $5.95 / output $7.65; High-capacity input $18.70 / output $22.10; Embeddings $3.40 per 1M. Estimated monthly spend: ~$1,581/month.

Notes / assumptions:
- IO billing: we bill tokens consumed for input and output separately; the ratecard attached shows decimal tokenization and rounding rules we use for billing.
- Minimums: no hard monthly minimum for hosted POCs, but committed contracts start at $1,000/month equivalent (we'd expect 5M/mo commitment to be comfortably above that).
- Pilot: standard 3-month pilot billed at list price; if customer converts to a 12-month committed contract within 30 days of pilot end, we apply the pilot charges as a one-time refundable credit against the committed contract (credit cannot exceed 3 months of list spend).
- Region: US-hosted only for listed pricing; EU residency pricing requires a separate quote.

Attachments: sample SOW/pilot_template (docx) and an itemized monthly spend table.

Next steps: if that looks reasonable I can produce a formal quote + draft SOW and a DocuSign link for the pilot. Happy to hop on a 20-min call tomorrow to walk the numbers (I can share a line-item spreadsheet).

Best,
Aditya Rao
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: PF_proposal_template.docx (DOCX, 65KB)]
